verses.1: You will know at the time of redemption that the rock will be raised up, and the rivers will be filled with water.
verses.2: Count the months, and you will know when it is time for your ritual.
verses.3: Their children will fall, their ropes will be broken, and they will be sent away.
verses.4: Their children will grow up and become old. They will go out, but they will never return.
verses.5: Who sent forth the free beings and who delivered those messages? Who revealed them?
verses.6: I have destroyed his house and all his dwellings.
verses.7: It will be played for the men; but the women shall not listen to it.
verses.8: The mountains rise from the east, and after all the plains, they continue to rise.
verses.9: May they serve you, if they truly love your father.
verses.10: It’s difficult to connect the ropes in such a thick manner, especially when you want to cross over those deep valleys.
verses.11: Be assured that he will have great power, and you will be able to get rid of him.
verses.12: Believe that your descendants and your livestock will be restored.
verses.13: The roaring wings were filled with the sound of Im-Eberah’s chanting.
verses.14: For you will leave this land in its state of decay and ruin.
verses.15: And she forgot that her feet would be lost, and the life of the field would be destroyed.
verses.16: Let her be filled with joy, so that she may not reach a state of emptiness without fear.
verses.17: For the Lord has given her wisdom, but He did not divide it among her.
verses.18: Now, in the chaos, it will be necessary to train the horse and its rider.
verses.19: Give the horse great power; let its chest be covered with armor.
verses.20: We were punished as if we had committed a terrible sin. May the Lord avenge us!
verses.21: They will dig deep into the depths, and with great strength, they will come forth to seek out those who are lost.
verses.22: He will play out in fear, and he will not return from the midst of destruction.
verses.23: On it will be a fire that burns like a torch and a sword.
verses.24: In the noise and chaos of the earth’s movements, no one will believe that it’s actually a voice from heaven.
verses.25: From afar, it will be said: “Ah! From far away, the sound of war can be heard.” There will be noise and chaos.
verses.26: May your understanding be like a bird that spreads its wings to fly high.
verses.27: If it is upon your face that the weight will be lifted, and if there will be no more pain.
verses.28: A rock will be placed on top of another rock, and they will be hung from it.
verses.29: From there, there’s a place where food can be found, far away from his eyes.
verses.30: And his wounds will bleed profusely. And when the demons are driven away from there, then it will be over.
